# Alphadent Fogászati Klinika Sopron

> Alphadent is a dental clinic in Sopron, Hungary, right at the Austrian border, in practice since 1996. It offers dental implants, oral surgery, cosmetic dentistry and tooth-preserving treatments. The website is available in Hungarian, English, German and Italian.

- Address: Arany János u. 13., 9400 Sopron, Hungary (next to Sopron railway station, about one hour by car from Vienna; free parking in the clinic's closed courtyard)
- Phone: +36 20 80 80 600
- Email: info@alpha-dent.eu
- Opening hours: Tuesday–Friday 8:00–17:00, Saturday 8:00–13:00, closed on Sunday and Monday (Europe/Budapest time)
- Appointments: by phone, by email, or with the "Book an appointment" button on any page, which opens a pre-filled appointment request email
- Languages spoken: Hungarian, German, English

## Main pages (English)

- [Home](https://alpha-dent.eu/en): Overview of the clinic, its services and how to book an appointment
- [Our clinic](https://alpha-dent.eu/en/our-clinic): The clinic, its 15-strong team, its equipment and its in-house dental lab
- [Services](https://alpha-dent.eu/en/services): All treatments offered
- [Implantology](https://alpha-dent.eu/en/services/implantology): Dental implants (CAMLOG), from planning and bone grafting to the final crown
- [Oral surgery](https://alpha-dent.eu/en/services/oral-surgery): Tooth extraction, wisdom tooth removal, bone grafting and other procedures
- [Cosmetic dentistry](https://alpha-dent.eu/en/services/cosmetic-dentistry): Aesthetic fillings, inlays and onlays, crowns, bridges, zirconia restorations and teeth whitening
- [Tooth-preserving treatments](https://alpha-dent.eu/en/services/tooth-preserving-treatments): Machine-assisted root canal treatment and other treatments that save natural teeth
- [FAQ](https://alpha-dent.eu/en/faq): Answers to common questions, including travel from Austria
- [Contact](https://alpha-dent.eu/en/contact): Address, opening hours, map and contact details
